nodes.summary: Let $V$ be an $n$-dimensional vector space over a field, $U$ a vector space, and $A : V \to V$, $B : U \to V$ linear maps with $\operatorname{Span} \{ A^i B u : u \in U, \ 0 \le i < n \} = V$ (the Kalman rank condition). Then for every monic polynomial $P$ of degree $n$ there is a linear map $K : V \to U$ such that $A + B K$ has characteristic polynomial $P$.
nodes.title: Pole-shifting theorem

nodes.summary: Let $V$ be an $n$-dimensional vector space over a field, $A : V \to V$ linear and $b \in V$ such that $b, A b, \dots, A^{n-1} b$ span $V$ (the Kalman rank condition for the single-input system $\dot x = A x + b u$). Then for every monic polynomial $P$ of degree $n$ there is a linear form $K$ on $V$ such that the closed-loop operator $A + bK : x \mapsto A x + K(x) \, b$ has characteristic polynomial $P$.
nodes.title: Pole placement for single-input systems

nodes.summary: Let $A \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times n}$ and $B \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times m}$ satisfy the Kalman rank condition $\operatorname{Span} \{ A^i B u : u \in \mathbb{R}^m, \ 0 \le i < n \} = \mathbb{R}^n$. Then there is $K \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}$ such that $A + BK$ has characteristic polynomial $(X + 1)^n$; in particular every complex eigenvalue of $A + BK$ equals $-1$, so $A + BK$ is Hurwitz.
nodes.title: Controllable linear systems have a Hurwitz closed loop

nodes.summary: Let $A \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times n}$ and $B \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times m}$ satisfy the Kalman rank condition. nodes.title: Exponential stabilisation of controllable linear systems

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
